title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-03-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard captures a stellar show featuring a trippy Cryptical reprise and a rollicking Uncle John's Band.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an excellent soundboard with crystal‑clear mix, making the performance easy to enjoy. Reviewers highlight the nostalgic Crytical Envelopment reprise and the exuberant Uncle John’s Band as standouts, describing the whole concert as “the real deal.” Overall the show is regarded as very good to exceptional.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and uniformly praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality, indicating a strong show with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as crisp and clear with no noted flaws; the soundboard capture is considered top‑notch.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows smoothly, with a nostalgic Crytical reprise and energetic set that keeps the momentum high throughout.
